pages.text: Mom drew pictures on a piece of paper. One loaf of bread, one potato, one bottle of milk, one apple.
"I want to hold this." Pongi took the paper.
The market was crowded. Pongi walked along, holding the paper tightly.
"One loaf of bread, please." Pongi crossed the bread off the paper.
They put in a potato too. They put in the milk too.
When they added the apple, everything on the paper had been crossed off. "We've bought it all!"
But the shopping basket was heavy. Pongi looked inside.
At the very bottom was a box of chocolates. That hadn't been on the paper.
Pongi looked at Dad. Dad looked the other way.
Mom drew chocolates at the top of a new piece of paper.
